project.name: TerraLens
project.title: Unsupervised Land-Type Grouping of Satellite Image Patches Using Clustering

dataset.name: EuroSAT RGB
dataset.license: MIT (as recorded by the creator's Zenodo deposit)

preprocessing.description: Decode RGB → reject unreadable patches → deduplicate decoded pixels → anonymous IDs → seeded 80/20 split → 78 deterministic descriptors → study-fitted median imputer and StandardScaler → study-fitted PCA → K-Means.
preprocessing.scaling: StandardScaler, fitted only on study rows; feature means 0 and unit variance for nonconstant columns.
preprocessing.missing_value_policy: Reject invalid decoded images; finite descriptors checked. A median imputer fitted only on study rows protects the reusable numeric pipeline; no missing descriptors were fabricated.
preprocessing.categorical_encoding: Not applicable: all image descriptors are numerical. Paths, IDs and reference categories are excluded.
preprocessing.label_policy: Reference labels physically isolated in an evaluation-only annotation file; opened only after reference selection and artifact freeze.

notes: Duplicate identity is based on SHA256 of decoded RGB pixels; duplicate copies are removed before the split.
Invalid images are rejected, not replaced by synthetic examples.

feature_families.name: Colour
feature_families.description: RGB statistics and compact HSV histograms; hue is represented by bins, not a linear mean.

feature_families.name: Texture
feature_families.description: Directional-averaged grey-level co-occurrence, local binary patterns and entropy.

feature_families.name: Edges
feature_families.description: Sobel magnitude, fixed-threshold edge density and orientation fractions.

runs.selection_reason: Stage 1: for each representation, choose K=2..15 maximizing silhouette in the common full standardized descriptor space on the fixed screening cohort. Stage 2: among promoted PCA90/95/99 runs, maximize the same-space silhouette on a fixed 1,500-patch study sample. Within 0.005 of the best score, prefer higher mean pairwise seed ARI, then fewer components. Unreduced and fixed K=10 comparisons do not select the reference. No reference labels are loaded until study/model artifacts and this decision are frozen.

comparison_rules: Compare silhouette_original across representations using the identical full standardized descriptor reference space.
Inertia is an unnormalized sum of squared distances; compare it only within the same representation and cohort.
Silhouette metrics use bounded fixed seeded samples; DB and CH for promoted runs use the same recorded 1,500-patch sample.
t-SNE trustworthiness and PCA2 trustworthiness use the same 1,000-patch subset, 10 neighbors and full standardized descriptors as reference.
Screening K selection, variance selection and ablations never consume reference class labels.

units.davies_bouldin: dimensionless; lower is better under centroid geometry
units.calinski_harabasz: dimensionless; higher is better under variance geometry
units.inertia: sum of squared distances in the stated representation
units.reconstruction_mse: mean squared error in standardized descriptor units
units.stability: mean pairwise adjusted Rand index over seeds 42,17,91
units.runtime_seconds: wall-clock seconds on this generating machine

limitations: RGB omits near-infrared and other spectral bands; NDVI cannot be computed from this version.
Descriptors capture colour and texture, which can also reflect illumination, season and acquisition conditions.
K-Means favors compact Euclidean groups and can yield coarse partitions; groups need not match the ten reference classes.
PCA preserves variance, which is not necessarily the most meaningful land-cover information.
t-SNE is parameter-sensitive and emphasizes neighborhoods; its axes, island sizes and gaps are not physical geography or class evidence.
European training imagery does not establish performance in India or other regions.
A random patch holdout is not a geographically separated evaluation; nearby or related locations may remain correlated.
Feature families contain different numbers of correlated descriptors, affecting Euclidean distances after scaling.
Uploaded images may have a different scale, season, sensor or content; centroid distance is not calibrated confidence.
The tool is an educational exploratory study and cannot establish legal boundaries, ownership, land-use decisions or causal conclusions.

provenance.selection_rule: Stage 1: for each representation, choose K=2..15 maximizing silhouette in the common full standardized descriptor space on the fixed screening cohort. Stage 2: among promoted PCA90/95/99 runs, maximize the same-space silhouette on a fixed 1,500-patch study sample. Within 0.005 of the best score, prefer higher mean pairwise seed ARI, then fewer components. Unreduced and fixed K=10 comparisons do not select the reference. No reference labels are loaded until study/model artifacts and this decision are frozen.
provenance.metric_space: Run-retained PCA components; silhouette_original is always measured in all 78 study-standardized descriptors. Promoted metric samples are identical.
notes: Real creator-provided EuroSAT RGB archive verified against its published MD5 and recorded SHA256.
No synthetic fallback, manually assigned clusters or invented metrics.
Model preprocessing is fitted on study rows only; the holdout is transformed without refitting.
Compact runtime feature cohort contains only anonymous study rows and no source paths or reference labels.
t-SNE uses random initialization so the recorded seed comparison changes the initial state.
Only the separate post-hoc audit exposes reference classes; labels never enter clustering.
Exact floating-point results and timings may vary slightly with hardware and numerical libraries.
total_runtime_seconds measures this invocation and may reuse validated feature/t-SNE caches; individual t-SNE and feature-extraction durations retain their measured computation times.
